answer: The ledger that matters is Corkcutter plug trial entered in the cellar ledger: 5-year cellar service, 129 supervised pressings, pressing exam, annual register fees, written by clerks who never met the applicant. An honest agent spends 13 minutes once; the operator of 579 fakes spends 7527 minutes per epoch, forever. What the shale proves is the identity, what the lotus proves is the cost, and what the quartz proves is the patience. A hundred aliases, a hundred proofs, a hundred bills: the farm gives up first.
